The Story

Two continents, one team, one promise.

Mel met Paul in South Africa over a glass of wine in 2015, proposed at Bridal Veil Falls on Leap Day 2016, and they married in 2017. That same all in approach is exactly how they sell homes: together, personally and with total commitment to the result.

Today they are three years running Premier Performers inside Queensland's number one Ray White office, and the names behind some of Townsville's standout sales of 2026.

  • Three sales at $1 million or more in a matter of weeks, 2026
